description: This file defines a React component 'TabbedUserModal' along with internal subcomponents 'UserDetailsView' and 'UserProjectsView'. It provides a modal interface for viewing user details and associated projects, utilizing hooks and external components like 'Modal' and 'useUserProjects'.

methods.name: UserDetailsView
methods.description: A presentational component that displays user details such as name, email, department, and tenant in a styled grid.

methods.name: UserProjectsView
methods.description: A component that fetches and displays a list of projects associated with a user, including loading and error states.

methods.name: TabbedUserModal
methods.description: Main component that renders a modal with tabs for user details and projects, managing tab state and rendering respective views.
